responsibility: Tests the framework’s result-reconstruction cursor logic. It builds a synthetic MIR body and mock analysis with uniquely identifiable states to verify that seeking between every block and effect position reconstructs the correct forward and backward dataflow state.
same_name_distinction: This `tests.rs` exercises the generic dataflow framework, especially `ResultsCursor` state reconstruction across statements and blocks. The other `tests.rs` belongs to coverage instrumentation and tests coverage-graph and counter behavior instead of framework mechanics.
